description: Cancel a Quote Link so the customer can no longer approve it: the customer link then says the quote was cancelled. Call it only when the user clearly asks to cancel or withdraw the quote. To change prices or options instead, use revise_quote_link. There is no tool to undo a cancel. The answers and versions so far are kept. Needs the quote's manage_token (the code after # in the private link https://www.workeey.com/q/m/#…; the whole private link is accepted too).

manage_token.description: The quote's private manage token: the long code after # in the private link (https://www.workeey.com/q/m/#<token>), returned as manage_token by create_quote_link. The whole private link is accepted too. Required, unless your MCP client already sends it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: cancel_quote_link
title: Cancel a Quote Link
